description: Strict contract for one timed XR preset from the phone-side library. The phone owns the preset clock and pushes this manifest to the glasses (XR Session Protocol v1, manifest_push). Each preset carries its own content timing: layers spawn/despawn on the preset timeline, and a timed gesture only switches to the next/previous preset or closes the current one. Static by design: no eye tracking, no dynamic depth occlusion — refusal of both is an energy and privacy advantage, not a compromise. Gesture semantics are global and fixed by gestureDictionaryVersion (v1: Swipe_Right = next preset, swipe after last preset = close; Swipe_Left = previous preset; Palm_Hold ~0.8s = close now; Pinch reserved) — they are NOT rebound per preset.

displayProfile.description: Target display class. additive = optical see-through (XREAL-style): black is transparent, so presets must use bright outlines and lit fills, never dark-alpha dependence. passthrough = video see-through with opaque display (e.g. Galaxy XR): full alpha compositing allowed. Fixed per preset so creators author against a known compositor.

gestureDictionaryVersion.description: Versioned gesture contract. MUST match GestureDictionary.Version compiled into the XR client — ManifestParser refuses to run on mismatch. Preset-level reading of v1: Swipe_Right = next preset (after last = close), Swipe_Left = previous preset, Palm_Hold ~0.8s = close now, Pinch reserved.

layers.description: Ordered layer stack, budget ~10 layers per preset; beyond that the client's LRU eviction applies (rev3 §3).

bundleUrl.description: State Bundle URL. GLB with baked skeletal animations (Appear, Idle, React); geometry pre-compressed with Draco/meshopt and textures in KTX2/Basis Universal by the creator pipeline (rev3 §1). May be a phone-local URI — the phone serves bundles, the glasses only render.

despawnAtMs.description: Preset-clock time when this layer despawns. MUST be > spawnAtMs. Omitted = layer lives until the preset ends.

fadeInMs.description: Opacity ramp after spawn. Cheap soft appearance without depth sensing.

fadeOutMs.description: Opacity ramp before despawn / preset end.

mode.description: v1: headLocked — object positioned in view space with a fixed offset, no dependency on CV (rev3 §4). phoneBody: v2 option — tracking the phone body as a static physical object for true 'above the screen' anchoring.

offset.description: Offset in metres, view space [x, y, z]. Example [0.0, 0.10, 0.60] ≈ 10 cm above the screen, 60 cm in front.

spawnAtMs.description: Preset-clock time when this layer spawns (state Appear -> Idle).

manifestVersion.description: Manifest format version. "2.0" = this timed-preset schema (timing is REQUIRED). v1 manifests (video-bound, no presetId/timing) are upgraded on library import by an explicit, documented rule: the phone assigns a presetId and a default timing block (durationMs: 15000, loop: false, onEnd: "close"; layers keep their spawnAtMs, despawnAtMs defaults to durationMs). No silent magic — the import rule is part of the contract.

presetId.description: Stable preset identifier in the phone-side library, e.g. "preset_retail_spring_01". Referenced by XR Session Protocol commands (preset_start / preset_stop / preset_switch).

timing.description: REQUIRED in v2. The preset's own content timing on the phone-owned preset clock. t=0 is preset_start.start_at_phone_ms.

durationMs.description: Total preset timeline length in milliseconds. Interactive ad presets target ≤ 15000 ms.

loop.description: Restart the timeline when it ends.

maxLoops.description: Loop cap. Ignored when loop = false.

onEnd.description: Behaviour when the timeline ends (and loops are exhausted): loop = restart, close = dismiss preset, hold = freeze on last frame until a gesture or preset_stop.

transition.description: How this preset appears/disappears on switch. Cheap, shader-free transitions only.

durationMs.description: Fade duration. 0 with type=cut = instant switch.

videoId.description: Optional content binding (rev3 §5). Standalone presets (e.g. ads) omit it.

title: XR Preset Manifest v2 — timed preset contract (phone → glasses)
